channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: Arizona State program aims to increase tree shade in Phoenix
item.description: Urban Nature, which is connected to the Julie Ann Wrigley Global Futures Laboratory at ASU, is identifying spots that need trees planted the most.

item.title: Chicago landscape company rebuilds after tornado damage
item.description: Tholens’ Landscape and Garden Center, located on the far south side of the community, had significant structural damage after the tornado earlier this month.

item.title: Lexington in Massachusetts bans gas-powered leaf blowers
item.description: The local bylaw carries fines of up to $200 for violations.

item.title: Virginia Green integrates, rebrands American Lawn and Tree Specialists
item.description: American Lawn and Tree Specialists will become Virginia Green's second Maryland branch, joining the Waldorf location that was established in 2025.

item.title: Case Construction Equipment recognizes winners of 2025 Dealer Awards
item.description: Comprised of four award categories, the program recognizes dealers with top honors for overall excellence, innovation, community impact and category-leading sales performance.

item.title: CU Denver students design landscape project aimed at accessibility
item.description: The project—which is in collaboration with Denver Mountain Parks—is one of several immersive experiences with real stakeholders that the students work on at CU Denver.

item.title: Massey Services opens 2 new service centers
item.description: The centers are in Euless, Texas and St. Augustine, Florida.

item.title: Franklin Electric appoints Duffy to senior business unit manager for industrial distribution
item.description: With nearly three decades of experience in the pumping industry, Bryan Duffy’s expertise spans a range of industrial markets.

item.title: Grasshopper Lawns opens new office in Bethlehem, PA
item.description: This marks the company’s second location.

item.title: Exscape Group acquires Buckeye Landscape Service in Columbus
item.description: The partnership brings together two brands with deep roots in Ohio.

item.title: Housecall Pro launches Trades 40 Under 40
item.description: Nominations are now open across the United States and Canada with a deadline of April 30. Honorees will be announced on May 20.

item.title: Mulhalls in Omaha launches Greenhall Commercial Landscapes
item.description: Mulhalls Garden + Home will continue to serve customers at its at its flagship location.

item.title: Charter Vista Holdings acquires LGD Lawn
item.description: The move expands Charter Vista's presence in the Southeast region and adds a New Orleans-area landscaping company to its portfolio.

item.title: Envu launches Horizon Spring Pest Advantage promotion
item.description: Featured products on the Horizon Spring Pest Advantage promotion include Temprid FX, Suspend PolyZone, Barricor Essential Mosquito Control and Maxforce Impact.

item.title: Not so bunny after all
item.description: The Easter bunny is a welcome guest on your landscapes this weekend. Other wildlife? Not so much. Here's 3 tips to help you prevent landscape destruction this spring.
